name: Kolonie visitor headers
description: Adds the caller's ASN as x-kolonie-asn. The ASN is not part of Cloudflare's Add visitor location headers managed transform, and the organisation name behind it is only reachable from a Worker (request.cf.asOrganization) — which kolonie-infra#63 declined, because another hop in front of every request is not worth a field nothing reads yet. The number is enough: the name is a lookup against a static list. Read by kolonie-platform#191, which stores it on agent_origins.

rules.description: Set x-kolonie-asn from ip.src.asnum for all proxied traffic
